summary: C&A is international Dutch chain of fashion retail clothing stores, founded in 1841. About 27,000 employees (Wikidata). Not found in the IND sponsor register. 100% of its 2 jobs here don't ask for Dutch. News, last 3 months: 2 about acquisitions; 2 about growth or hiring.
sources: IND public register (work / highly skilled migrants), fetched 2026-10-06, https://ind.nl/en/public-register-recognised-sponsors/public-register-regular-labour-and-highly-skilled-migrants
Google News RSS (headline and link only), last 90 days, fetched 2026-10-06

culture.text: A clothing retailer started by Dutch brothers, with shops across Europe and owned by the Brenninkmeijer family.

open.text: It is not listed as an IND recognised sponsor.

growth.text: Staff fell from about 35,000 in 2017 to 27,000 in 2024.
Its store in Deventer is closing.

worth_knowing.text: The owning family has named its CFO to lead the 185-year-old business.
